targets.outcome_quote: Again, it can be concluded that no difference in Stroop interference scores was detected when comparing the Stereotype threat condition and the control condition.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The focal published facilitation effect was absent in both sampling stages, and the observed pattern was opposite to the original.
